prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign-In After Pet Selection: Move sign-in step to occur after pet adoption selection so users build attachment before authenticating. (why: Sign-in currently drops 27.1% of users before they interact with pets, and 8 users reported account sync issues when signing in early.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Redesign Pet Picker Grid & Live Preview: Redesign the pet selection screen into a visual grid with clear choice cards. (why: Adoption has a low conversion rate of 60.9% and takes a median of 89s, indicating users struggle with selection options.)
2: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Pet Control Walkthrough: Add an interactive desktop control card list on the welcome screen showing hotkeys to hide, move, and talk to your pet. (why: Multiple support emails reported confusion on how to control, hide, or interact with pets once onboarding finished.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Account Sync Safeguard Notice: Display a hint on the sign-in screen confirming existing cloud pets will be retained without resetting. (why: 8 support emails reported lost or reset pets after signing in again, causing severe user frustration.)
4: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Guidance Hint: Add bright image photo upload guidelines to prevent generation failures for custom pets. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or distorted pet visuals during creation.)
5: [home, wait_info] Interactive Wait Screen Activity: Add a tip carousel and estimated time indicator to the waiting generation screen. (why: Home step has a massive mean time of 2336s with drop-offs occurring while waiting for setup.)
6: [choose_path, layout] Simplified Path Selection Cards: Change path choice layout to split cards clearly highlighting quick adoption vs custom creation. (why: 23.8% of users drop out on choose_path step, taking a mean time of 514s to make a choice.)
7: [home, notification] Ready Desktop System Notification: Add a desktop notification toggle when pet setup finishes loading in background. (why: Median wait time on home is 201s (mean 2336s), causing users to switch windows and assume app stalled.)
8: [finish, incentive] Adoption Certificate Mascot Celebration: Add a mascot celebration animation on the completion welcome screen before final desktop reveal. (why: Finish step drops 35.2% of remaining users after taking a 395s median time.)

scores.note: Reordering sign-in after pet choice leverages emotional investment to recover sign-in drop-offs.
Grid redesign simplifies selection, targeting the highest drop-off step (39.1%).
Interactive walkthrough directly addresses reported user confusion at the finish step.
Low-cost copy hint relieves account reset fears raised by multiple support tickets.
Easy copy fix to prevent custom pet photo upload failures for edge cases.
Carousel reduces perceived wait time during long background pet generation.
Clear split cards help users decide faster and decrease early path choice drop-off.
System notification re-engages users who tab away during high-latency generation.
Celebration animation adds delight to encourage completing the final step.
